title: Manual Muscle Testing (MMT)
summary: Grade strength from 0 to 5 like an expert: positions, stabilisation, resistance, gravity-minimised testing and substitutions for 46 muscle tests.
ur: Muscle ki taaqat 0 se 5 tak grade karna — sahi position, stabilisation, resistance aur substitutions ke saath.
atlasTitles: Finger MCP flexion with IP extension

goals.beginner: Know what each grade means and why gravity decides grade 3.
goals.intermediate: Test any muscle with the right position, stabilisation and resistance.
goals.advanced: Grade 0–2 and +/− grades; catch every substitution.
goals.expert: Read weakness patterns (root, nerve, UMN, muscle) and pass OSCE stations.

sources: Avers & Brown — Daniels and Worthingham's Muscle Testing (10th ed.)
Kendall et al. — Muscles: Testing and Function with Posture and Pain (5th ed.)
ASIA — International Standards for Neurological Classification of SCI (ISNCSCI)

title: Goniometry
summary: Measure joint range like an expert: landmarks, axis and arm alignment, normal ranges, end-feels and substitutions for 38 joint motions — with a drag-the-goniometer trainer.
ur: Joint ki range ko goniometer se sahi naapna — axis, arms, normal values, end-feel aur ghaltiyon ke saath.

goals.beginner: Know the goniometer, the 0–180 system and normal ranges.
goals.intermediate: Place the axis and arms correctly for every major joint.
goals.advanced: Recognise end-feels, capsular patterns and measurement errors.
goals.expert: Interpret limitation, track meaningful change and report like a specialist.

sources: Norkin & White — Measurement of Joint Motion: A Guide to Goniometry (5th ed.)
American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) — Joint Motion: Method of Measuring and Recording
Morrey et al. — functional elbow range

title: Dermatomes & Sensory Testing
summary: Find every key sensory point from C2 to S4–S5, test light touch and pinprick properly, and read sensory patterns — root, nerve, polyneuropathy or cord.
ur: Har dermatome ka key sensory point dhoondna, light touch aur pinprick sahi tareeqe se test karna, aur sensory pattern se lesion samajhna.

goals.beginner: Point to every key sensory point from C2 to S4–S5.
goals.intermediate: Test light touch and pinprick correctly and score them.
goals.advanced: Tell root, nerve, polyneuropathy and cord patterns apart.
goals.expert: Find the sensory level, recognise red flags and pass OSCE stations.

sources: ASIA — International Standards for Neurological Classification of Spinal Cord Injury (ISNCSCI, 2019 revision)

title: Myotomes & Key Muscles
summary: Screen every root from C1 to S2 with one movement each, know the ISNCSCI key muscles, and combine myotome, dermatome and reflex to name the level.
ur: Har root (C1 se S2) ki ek movement test karna, ISNCSCI key muscles yaad rakhna aur dermatome + reflex ke saath level pehchaanna.

goals.beginner: Name the movement for every myotome from C1 to S2.
goals.intermediate: Test each myotome correctly and know the ISNCSCI key muscles.
goals.advanced: Combine myotome, dermatome and reflex to localise a root.
goals.expert: Separate root, nerve and cord lesions; classify spinal cord injury.

title: Reflexes & UMN Signs
summary: Elicit and grade every deep tendon reflex, use reinforcement, and recognise upper-motor-neuron signs — Babinski, Hoffmann, clonus and jaw jerk.
ur: Har tendon reflex sahi nikaalna aur 0 se 4+ grade karna, aur UMN signs (Babinski, Hoffmann, clonus) pehchaanna.

goals.beginner: Know each reflex, its root and the normal response.
goals.intermediate: Elicit reflexes reliably, with reinforcement, and grade 0–4+.
goals.advanced: Interpret reduced and brisk reflexes and UMN signs.
goals.expert: Localise lesions — root, cord, brainstem — from reflex patterns.

sources: Lindsay, Bone & Fuller — Neurology and Neurosurgery Illustrated

title: Peripheral Nerve Examination
summary: Examine 15 key nerves — roots, muscles, sensory areas, quick tests and classic lesion signs — plus neurodynamic tests (ULNTs, SLR, slump, prone knee bend).
ur: Har bari nerve ki roots, muscles, sensory area aur lesion sign — aur neurodynamic tests (ULNT, SLR, slump).

goals.beginner: Know each nerve's roots and key muscles.
goals.intermediate: Test each nerve's motor and sensory function quickly.
goals.advanced: Recognise classic lesions and where they happen.
goals.expert: Tell nerve, root and plexus apart; perform neurodynamic tests.

sources: Aids to the Examination of the Peripheral Nervous System (Guarantors of Brain / MRC)

title: Tone & Coordination
summary: Grade spasticity with the Modified Ashworth and Tardieu scales, tell spasticity from rigidity, and examine coordination and balance — finger-nose, heel-shin, Romberg and more.
ur: Spasticity ko MAS aur Tardieu se grade karna, rigidity se farq karna, aur coordination tests sahi tareeqe se karna.

goals.beginner: Know what tone is and what each coordination test checks.
goals.intermediate: Perform MAS, Tardieu and coordination tests correctly.
goals.advanced: Separate spasticity, rigidity, cerebellar and sensory ataxia.
goals.expert: Use findings to guide treatment and pass neuro OSCE stations.

sources: O'Sullivan, Schmitz & Fulk — Physical Rehabilitation (7th ed.)
